storyCards.headline: Buttons: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Pussycat Dolls's "Buttons" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 30 weeks on the chart.

Buttons was released in 2005.
